source_name: Government of Andhra Pradesh eProcurement public tenders
observations: The anonymous home page exposes current tender IDs, references, titles and closing dates.
The full current-tender page exposes department, tender ID, notice number, category, work title, estimated value, Start Date & Time, Closing Date & Time and a session-bound action.
A public tender detail opened through the portal UI confirmed that Start Date & Time is the tender/bid download start; the listing and detail did not expose a publication timestamp.
The complete table JSON returned no rows unless the portal's undocumented client-side encrypted form state was generated.
Tender detail is a session-bound POST and the portal does not publish a stable per-record detail URL.
reason: No reliable anonymous adapter can reproduce the complete feed without automating or reimplementing the portal's client-side encrypted integrity flow. No publication timestamp is exposed for the canonical notice record. The app must not fabricate either field or bypass this portal control.
required_resolution: Obtain a documented public export/API or written permission and a supported machine-readable access contract from Andhra Pradesh eProcurement.
